usage.label: dismiss A as B
usage.explanationZh: 把A視為B而不予理會／考慮。

usage.label: dismiss sb from his / her job
bear a close resemblance to...
usage.explanationZh: 和……很相似；＝look very much like...。

usage.label: resemble 的及物用法
usage.explanationZh: resemble本身是及物動詞，不得與介詞like並用。

usage.label: protest that + 子句
usage.explanationZh: protest表反駁時是及物動詞，用that子句作受詞。

usage.label: come to a halt / stop
usage.explanationZh: 停頓下來；＝grind to a halt / stop。

usage.label: be peculiar to + 地方
usage.explanationZh: 是某地所獨有的；＝be native to + 地方；＝be indigenous to + 地方。

usage.label: a man of high / good repute
withdraw, withdrew, withdrawn
usage.explanationZh: withdraw的過去式為withdrew，過去分詞為withdrawn。

usage.label: await / wait for
usage.explanationZh: 均表等待；await後接抽象事物作受詞，若接人作受詞，帶有預期某事會發生在某人身上之意；wait for可接任何表人或事物的名詞作受詞。

usage.label: grind, ground, ground
usage.explanationZh: grind的過去式及過去分詞皆為ground。

usage.label: grind to a halt / stop
usage.explanationZh: 停頓下來；＝come to a halt / stop。

usage.label: ground, grounded, grounded
usage.explanationZh: ground也可作名詞表土地，作動詞表使某人禁足或使停飛；此動詞的三態為ground、grounded、grounded，與grind的過去式不同。

usage.label: be grateful to sb for sth
usage.explanationZh: 就某事對某人表示感激；＝be thankful to sb for sth；＝be indebted to sb for sth。

usage.label: alert sb to sth
usage.explanationZh: 提醒某人警覺某事；＝awaken sb to sth。

usage.label: transform A into B
usage.explanationZh: 將A改變為B；＝convert A into B；＝change A into B；＝turn A into B。

usage.label: split sth in two / in half
split up with sb
usage.explanationZh: 與某人分手；＝break up with sb。

usage.label: a banana split
usage.explanationZh: 香蕉聖代；香蕉船（冰淇淋）。

usage.label: and 連接名詞時動詞單複數
usage.explanationZh: 兩個名詞視為一體時可當單數而使用單數動詞；視為兩個獨立名詞以and連接時須使用複數動詞。
